messages:
jess: Quick heads-up — RC candidate failed a quick e2e in staging, holding the canary. ETA update: aiming to push announce to 10:30 PT but will probably slip. tagging @sam @maria for rollback/patch plan.

sam: On it. kicking off smoke + a small load ramp now, will report in ~12m.

devops-bot: CI pipeline #rc-2024-03: smoke-tests started (build 4821). Logs: https://ci.redwood.test/build/4821

maria: If we need to roll back, I already prepped a hotfix branch: release/hf-rc3. Cherry-pick list is small (tokenizer fix + pool guard). Command I used:```git checkout -b release/hf-rc3 origin/rc && git cherry-pick a1b2c3d && git cherry-pick e4f5g6```

ryan: Could we do a limited announce (console + internal docs) while we hold public? Marketing might prefer a partial signal.

elaine: Marketing flagged customer comms — they prefer a firm ETA rather than silence. If we slip, they want a short reason line and new ETA.

jess: Decision update: hold public announce for now. We'll attempt patch; if green by 10:45 PT we send full announce, otherwise we post a slip notice with brief cause + new ETA. Putting canary on pause.

sam: Smoke passed. Load test still failing on a seq-length regression (repro steps added in the CI artifact). Investigating thread in the run logs.

maria: Found a race in the worker pool under long sequences; preparing a small fix. Will push PR in ~10m and tag for fast-track review. If it doesn't land, we revert to release/hf-rc3.

sam: PR merged to rc branch and build restarted. Canary resuming in 2m.

devops-bot: Canary rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100% scheduled. Observability alerts watch: request_latency, error_rate.

jess: Nice work. I'll draft the announce/slip copy in #announcements/drafts now and schedule for 10:45 PT if we stay green. @liz-marketing please review the blurb when you can.

liz-marketing: On it — I'll review in the next 5 and ping back. :thumbsup:

jess: Final — canary reached 100% and no new errors in the window. Announce scheduled for 10:45 PT. Thanks team.
